hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.dollar_year: not stated (WSDOT societal costs applied to 2023 crashes)
rules: K and A priced the same, one cost per level for every location type

statewide_rates.missing: WSDOT publishes none: it 'no longer uses crash rates for decision-making' (Safety Analysis Guide, Aug 2024, PDF p. 24, printed p. 19)

screening.state_method: HSM safety performance functions with Empirical Bayes, expected fatal and serious crashes (Safety Analysis Guide, Aug 2024, PDF p. 11; HSIP Implementation Plan 2024, PDF p. 50)

min_years.page: §6.4, PDF p. 18-19 (printed p. 13-14): five full calendar years

spf_calibration.missing: WSDOT uses the HSM default calibration factor 1.00 (Safety Analysis Guide PDF p. 20); no SPF engine in CrashIQ
